second_method.method: independent count of answer-side keys (77 numbered keys + 1 unnumbered match block(s)) + 1 question(s) with no printed key

count_gate.note: No difficulty distribution table is printed in this LBA -> quota_table 'absent' (ruling R-E6). Question side 1-79 in order, no repeats or gaps. Answer side 1-35, unnumbered match block (10 rows), 37-68, '69.' on the four-mark heading (stray), q069's answer printed as a list labelled 69-72, key '73.' answering q070 (EMPTY + pointer), 71-78 aligned; q079 (map, sourceless) no key. Difficulty per question: easy 54, average 17, difficult 8, untagged 0.

method_notes: Pages: Q pdf 101 (heading, LO 8 bullets) 102-106 (q79 outline map pdf 106); A pdf 195-200 (the last pages of the LBA).

Sections: s1 MCQ q1-5; s2 fill q6-20; s3 T/F q21-35; s4 '36. Match the following appropriately (easy)' q36 (10 rows); s5 one mark q37-51 vsa; s6 two marks q52-58 sa; s7 three marks q59-68 sa; s8 four marks q69-79 la.

NUMBERING (analysis reports/class-4-evs/evs-4-25_numbering_analysis.md): stray '69.' on the four-mark heading; q069 answer = list labelled 69-72 (sub-items, ruled); the first '73.' answers q070 (one-question band, default lane); 71-78 aligned. '*' printed on the number line of keys 71, 72, 74, 75 is the first bullet glyph (stripped).

TOPICS (ruling R-E7): map v1 evs-4-25 sections s00 Introduction (not tickable), s01 The rivers, s02 Places of attraction. One clear section -> that section ('content', 'high'); intro content (map, states, districts, natural regions, crops, occupations) and mixed -> both tickable sections ('content', 'low'); s00 never used. Mapping in the unit summary.

q1 options printed with lower-case labels on one line (set by hand). q28 key 'False (It's a tiger reserve)' — option false, note kept in answer_as_printed. Match key letters do not follow column B's letters (values do) — pairs by value.
Transcription: evs_auto.py rules (as evs-4-01) + the overrides in build file build_25_evs.py; marks per ruling R-E5; topic per R-E3.
